name: Strategic Visual Storytelling Using Claude and Perplexity
headline: Strategic Visual Storytelling Using Claude
short_description: This skill enables users to use the combined power of Perplexity and Claude to create compelling visual presentations from industry data. It guides users through gathering up-to-date insights and converting them into stunning visuals for stakeholders.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The Strategic Visual Storytelling skill combines the capabilities of Claude and Perplexity to empower users in crafting visually compelling presentations from industry data. This skill guides users through the process of gathering the latest insights and transforming them into engaging visuals that resonate with stakeholders. By utilizing this skill, users can enhance their storytelling capabilities, making data not just informative but also visually appealing. One of the primary benefits of this skill is its ability to save time and streamline the presentation creation process. Users can implement this skill in just one hour, allowing them to quickly generate strategic visualizations that can replace traditional, text-heavy reports. This efficiency is particularly valuable for professionals who need to present data-driven insights in a clear and engaging manner, thus enhancing their communication effectiveness. This skill is particularly beneficial for content creators, product managers, and AI practitioners who are looking to elevate their presentations. By utilizing the Strategic Visual Storytelling skill, these professionals can create industry outlook visualizations, transform mundane reports into captivating presentations, and generate strategic recommendations through visual dashboards. Such practical applications can significantly improve stakeholder engagement and decision-making processes. While the implementation of this skill is categorized as intermediate, it requires no extensive technical background, making it accessible to a wide range of users. As businesses increasingly adopt AI-first workflows, integrating this skill into their processes can enhance their ability to communicate insights visually, thereby aligning with modern expectations for data presentation. By leveraging AI automation through Claude and Perplexity, users can ensure their visual storytelling is not only impactful but also efficient.
Creating industry outlook visualizations
Transforming boring reports into engaging presentations
Generating strategic recommendations based visual dashboards
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
1. Start by using Perplexity for real-time research. Use search operators to 
   focus on reputable sources for [INDUSTRY] insights and save relevant PDFs.
2. Move to Claude, create a new project, and upload all gathered documents.
3. Set custom preferences in Claude for visual outputs, including chart types 
   like [CHART_TYPE] for [INSIGHT_TYPE]. 
4. Use the following prompt on Claude: 
   "Generate a visual dashboard with insights from the provided resources. Highlight 
   key findings using preferred chart types, and suggest three strategic recommendations."
5. Turn on the 'thinking mode' for a comprehensive response.
```
Copy

```
Dashboard with sections titled 'Growth Rates', 'Market Trends', including bar and line charts. 
Key strategic recommendations like 'Expand Distribution Channels' highlighted.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
Advanced skill - requires experience with AI agents
